name: cineweave-director
description: Codex-first general Prompt management, director, storyboard, cinematography, cinematic text-to-image and provider-neutral render planning workflow for CineWeave Worlds.

interface.shortDescription: Manage general Prompts, cinematic storyboards and safe render plans.
interface.longDescription: CineWeave Director manages general text-to-image Prompts as versioned assets with domains, tags, variables, semantic references, variants, evaluation and repair history. It also turns World context and creator intent into professional director decisions, shot-by-shot storyboards, camera language, cinematic-realistic provider-neutral prompt packages, human-gated RenderPlans, verified Draft media metadata, receipt-backed PromptHypotheses, structured DirectingSpec inputs and Codex draft briefs. It never installs Skills, generates through the Web app, writes Canon, or submits a paid Provider handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use CineWeave Director to create or manage this text-to-image Prompt, or turn this World context and creative intent into a director proposal, storyboard sequence, cinematic-realistic frame prompt and human-gated RenderPlan.
